summary: Iteration 34 - Phase D+E Features Testing Complete. All 26 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI tests verified all key features. Phase D+E features include: Adviser campus switcher, Chat auto-detect direct/group, GDPR accessible to all, Venue offsite/non-bookable options, Extension in staff profile, QR code check-in, Auto-attendant & call queues, Call forwarding rules, Outgoing call rules, Events ordering (upcoming first), Outreach auto-events.

issues: Minor: Missing aria-describedby for DialogContent (accessibility warning in console)

seed_data_creation: None - used existing data, test data cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 34 Phase D+E features all verified: (1) Adviser campus switcher - CAMPUS_SWITCHER_ROLES includes 'adviser', has_campus_switcher function works. (2) Chat auto-detect - New Conversation dialog auto-detects direct vs group based on participant count, auto-names direct messages. (3) GDPR accessible - 'My Privacy' link visible in main nav for all roles. (4) Venue offsite/non-bookable - VenueCreate/Update models have is_offsite, is_bookable, country, address fields working. (5) Extension in staff profile - Extension field in Account tab of UserEditDialog, managed via calling API. (6) QR check-in - POST /api/checkins/qr-scan endpoint working, looks up member by ID/national_id/email/pin. (7) Auto-attendant - GET/PUT /api/calling/auto-attendant with greeting, menu options, business hours. (8) Call queues - CRUD /api/calling/queues with strategies: ring_all, round_robin, least_recent, random. (9) Call forwarding - GET/PUT /api/calling/forwarding/{user_id} working. (10) Outgoing rules - CRUD /api/calling/outgoing-rules with pattern matching. (11) Events ordering - Events sorted with upcoming first then by date. (12) Outreach auto-events - Deleting programme auto-deletes associated events.

adviser_campus_switcher.details: CAMPUS_SWITCHER_ROLES includes 'adviser'. has_campus_switcher function returns true for advisers. set_active_campus and clear_active_campus endpoints work.

chat_auto_detect.details: New Conversation dialog auto-detects direct vs group based on participant count. Shows 'Group chat (2+ participants selected)' message when multiple participants added.

gdpr_accessible.details: 'My Privacy' link visible in main navigation sidebar for all roles. /api/gdpr/settings endpoint accessible.

venue_offsite_nonbookable.details: VenueCreate/Update models have is_offsite (bool), is_bookable (bool), country (str), address (str) fields. Create and update operations work correctly.

extension_in_profile.details: Extension field visible in Account tab of UserEditDialog. Extensions managed via /api/calling/extensions API, not admin user update.

qr_checkin.details: POST /api/checkins/qr-scan endpoint exists and works. Accepts qr_data and looks up member by ID, national_id, email, or pin. Returns 404 for invalid QR, 400 for empty QR.

auto_attendant.details: GET /api/calling/auto-attendant returns default config if none exists. PUT /api/calling/auto-attendant updates config with greeting, menu_options, business_hours.

call_queues.details: CRUD operations on /api/calling/queues work. Supports strategies: ring_all, round_robin, least_recent, random. Queue has name, timeout, max_wait, members, announce_position.

call_forwarding.details: GET /api/calling/forwarding/{user_id} returns forwarding rules. PUT updates rules with forward_always, forward_busy, forward_no_answer, forward_offline.

outgoing_rules.details: CRUD on /api/calling/outgoing-rules works. Rules have name, pattern (regex), action (allow/block/prefix), priority, enabled.

events_ordering.details: Events sorted with status_order: upcoming=0, ongoing=1, completed=2, cancelled=3. Then sorted by date within each status.

outreach_auto_events.details: Creating recurring programme auto-generates calendar events. Deleting programme calls db.events.delete_many with outreach_program_id filter.

public_calendar_country_detection.details: PublicBookingsPage auto-detects country from timezone using Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone.
